'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Ukrainian officials say that four people have been killed and six others have been injured in a [[Rocket (weapon)|rocket]] attack in [[Sumy]] overnight. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/four-killed-overnight-rocket-strike-outskirts-ukraines-sumy-governor-2022-06-16/ (Reuters)]
***The mayor of [[Melitopol]] claims that Ukrainian farmers caused "mass illness" in Russian troops by [[List of man-made mass poisoning incidents|poisoning]] [[cherries]]. [https://www.thedailybeast.com/ukrainian-farmers-poison-russian-troops-with-spiked-cherries-as-guerrilla-war-terrifies-invaders (The Daily Beast)]
*The United States announces the capture of a senior [[ISIL]] leader in [[Syria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/16/isil-leader-detained-in-syria-us-led-coalition (Al Jazeera)]
*One [[Sudan]]ese protester is shot dead after a flare up of anti-military protests in [[Khartoum]] and [[Omdurman]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/sudan-protester-shot-dead-protests-flare-following-military-civilian-meeting-2022-06-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute]]
**European benchmark [[natural gas prices]] increase by around 30% after Russia's [[Gazprom]] reduced [[Nord Stream 1]]'s gas supply to [[Germany]] to 40% of the pipeline's capacity. Russia blames maintenance problems resulting from Canada's refusal to return equipment that was sent for repair and warns that usage of the pipeline could be completely suspended. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russian-gas-flows-europe-fall-further-amid-diplomatic-tussle-2022-06-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]]
**Oil prices increase in the [[United States]] following the [[Biden administration]]'s announcement of new [[sanctions against Iran]]'s petrochemicals industry. The sanctions are an effort to force [[Iran]] to comply with the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]], from which the United States unilaterally [[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|withdrew in 2018]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/16/us-targets-chinese-uae-companies-in-fresh-iran-sanctions (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/oil-rebounds-after-steep-drop-underpinned-by-tight-supplies-2022-06-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are killed and five others are injured in a building fire in the town of [[Handlova]], [[Slovakia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/slovakia-bratislava-fires-b5a9d590b65093f2bfda5f3405471055 (AP)]
*Firefighters fight wildfires across [[Catalonia]] and [[Navarre]], [[Spain]], as temperatures reach {{convert|40|°C|°F}}, complicating the efforts of the firefighters. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/06/16/wildfires-rage-in-catalonia-amid-soaring-heatwave-temperatures (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Sergey Vladimirovich Cherkasov|Sergey Cherkasov]], a Russian [[GRU (Russian Federation)|military intelligence official]], is expelled from the [[Netherlands]] for attempting to begin an internship at the [[International Criminal Court]] in [[The Hague]] using a fake [[Brazil]]ian identity. Cherkasov will now face a criminal trial in Brazil. [https://www.theguardian.com/law/2022/jun/16/russian-spy-caught-trying-to-infiltrate-war-crimes-court-says-netherlands (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/netherlands-says-russian-spy-caught-seeking-war-crimes-court-internship-2022-06-16/ (Reuters)]
*Three people are killed in a shooting at an [[Episcopal Church (United States)|Episcopal Church]] in [[Vestavia Hills, Alabama]], United States. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/alabama-church-shooting-st-stephens-today-b2103137.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 NBA Finals]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[Golden State Warriors]] defeat the [[Boston Celtics]] in six games to win their fourth [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] championship in [[2014–15 Golden State Warriors season|eight years]]. [[Stephen Curry]] is named [[NBA Finals Most Valuable Player Award|NBA Finals MVP]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2022/06/16/nba-finals-game-6/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://kion546.com/news/2022/06/16/warriors-crowned-2022-nba-champions-curry-wins-first-finals-mvp/ (KION-TV)]
